paragraphs.en: Use an iPhone, iPad, or spare Mac as a true second display for your Mac without restrictions.
paragraphs.zh: 将 iPhone、iPad 或闲置的 Mac 用作 Mac 的真正的第二块显示器，且不受任何限制。

paragraphs.en: Turn your spare devices into second monitors for your Mac — free, open source, no subscription.
paragraphs.zh: 将您的闲置设备变成 Mac 的第二块显示器——免费、开源、无需订阅。

paragraphs.en: iPhone, iPad, spare Macs, and Android (beta); a Linux sender and receiver are in beta too. A self-hosted alternative to Apple Sidecar, Duet Display, and Luna Display: true extended display (not just mirroring), Retina-sharp, over USB or WiFi, with touch and scroll input.

paragraphs.en: Why OpenDisplay exists Turning an iPhone or iPad into an external display for a Mac is a solved problem — but every existing option has a catch:
paragraphs.zh: 为什么会有 OpenDisplay 将 iPhone 或 iPad 变成 Mac 的外接显示器是一个已经被解决的问题——但现有的每一种方案都有一个缺陷：

paragraphs.en: OpenDisplay is the missing option: a free, open-source, no-account, no-dongle way to use the iOS device you already own as a true second display. If you were about to write your own — don't! Contribute here instead; the hard parts (virtual display creation, low-latency H.264 pipeline, USB transport, input injection) are already working.
paragraphs.zh: OpenDisplay 正是缺失的那一环：一种免费、开源、无需账户、无需加密狗的方案，让你把已有的 iOS 设备用作真正的第二块显示器。 如果你正打算自己写一个——别了！ 来这里参与贡献吧；那些难写的部分（虚拟显示器创建、低延迟 H.264 流水线、USB 传输、输入注入）都已经可以工作了。

paragraphs.en: Why do I see the purple screen-recording indicator in the menu bar? That's a macOS privacy indicator shown for any app that captures the screen — Duet, Luna, OBS, and Zoom trigger it too. Apple Sidecar doesn't, only because it's implemented inside the OS rather than on public capture APIs. It cannot (and shouldn't) be hidden by an app; it's how macOS tells you a capture is running.
paragraphs.zh: 为什么我会在菜单栏看到紫色的屏幕录制指示器？ 这是 macOS 的隐私指示器，任何截取屏幕的应用都会触发它——Duet、Luna、OBS 和 Zoom 也会触发它。 Apple Sidecar 不会触发，只是因为它的实现是在操作系统内部，而不是通过公开的截取 API。 应用无法（也不应该）隐藏它；它正是 macOS 用来告知你正在进行屏幕截取的方式。

paragraphs.en: The Mac app doesn't show my iPhone in the Connection menu (WiFi). Both sides need Local Network permission, and both fail silently without it: check Privacy & Security → Local Network on the Mac and on the iPhone, make sure both are on the same WiFi network, and keep the iPhone app open in the foreground. USB mode is unaffected.
paragraphs.zh: Mac 应用在「连接」菜单中不显示我的 iPhone（WiFi 模式）。 双方都需要「本地网络」权限，缺少该权限时双方都会静默失败：请在 Mac 和 iPhone 上检查「隐私与安全性」→「本地网络」，确保两者处于同一个 WiFi 网络，并保持 iPhone 应用在前台打开。USB 模式不受影响。

paragraphs.en: What USB cable or version do I need? Your cable must support data — a charge-only USB cable will not work. Look for a cable described as a data , sync , or charging and data-transfer cable. A data-capable USB 2.0 cable is enough; USB 3, Thunderbolt, and video Alt Mode are not required. OpenDisplay streams video over a TCP connection through macOS's built-in usbmuxd , not as a USB video device. Its highest-quality preset uses 18 Mb/s, well below USB 2.0's 480 Mb/s high-speed link rate, so USB 2.0 has ample bandwidth for the stream. USB 1.x is not supported or tested. For best reliability, use a known-good data/sync cable, unlock the device, accept the Trust This Computer prompt if it appears, and avoid unreliable hubs or adapters.
paragraphs.zh: 我需要什么USB数据线或什么版本的USB？ 您的数据线必须支持数据传输——仅充电的USB数据线无法使用。 请选择标注为「数据线」、「同步线」或「充电与数据传输线」的数据线。 一条支持数据的USB 2.0数据线就足够了；无需USB 3、Thunderbolt或视频Alt Mode。 OpenDisplay通过macOS内置的usbmuxd以TCP连接传输视频流，而不是作为USB视频设备工作。 其最高质量预设使用18 Mb/s，远低于USB 2.0的480 Mb/s高速链路速率，因此USB 2.0拥有充足的带宽来传输视频流。 不支持也不测试USB 1.x。 为获得最佳可靠性，请使用质量可靠的数据/同步线，解锁设备，在出现「信任此电脑」提示时予以接受，并避免使用不可靠的集线器或转接器。

paragraphs.en: Can another Mac be the display? Yes. Install OpenDisplay Receiver (a separate, small app from the same release) on the spare Mac. It only needs macOS 12 Monterey or newer, so Macs from around 2015 onward qualify even though the sending Mac needs macOS 14. The receiver shows up on the sending Mac like a phone does and becomes a real extended Retina display. Over WiFi it works out of the box. For a cable, connect the two Macs with a Thunderbolt or USB4 cable (macOS creates a Thunderbolt Bridge network between them), with an Ethernet cable or adapters, or — on recent macOS on both Macs — a plain USB-C data cable (macOS runs a small network link over it; approve the allow accessory to connect prompt on each Mac, which appears depending on which Mac is plugged into which). The sender moves the session onto the cable automatically, even one plugged in mid-session, and the device row says Cable . Older Macs with a Mini DisplayPort-shaped Thunderbolt 1 or 2 port work with a Thunderbolt 3 to 2 adapter and a Thunderbolt 2 cable. Input from the receiving Mac's keyboard and mouse is a follow-up ( #147 ).
paragraphs.zh: 另一台 Mac 可以作为显示器吗？可以。 在备用的 Mac 上安装 OpenDisplay Receiver（同一发布版本中的另一个独立小型应用）。 它只需要 macOS 12 Monterey 或更新版本，因此大约 2015 年以后的 Mac 都符合条件，尽管发送端 Mac 需要 macOS 14。 该接收端会像手机一样显示在发送端 Mac 上，并成为一个真正的扩展 Retina 显示器。 通过 WiFi 开箱即可使用。 若使用线缆连接，可以用雷雳或 USB4 线缆连接两台 Mac（macOS 会在它们之间创建雷雳桥接网络），也可以用以太网线缆或转接器，或者——在两台 Mac 都运行较新版本的 macOS 时——使用普通的 USB-C 数据线（macOS 会通过它运行一个小型网络连接；在每台 Mac 上批准「允许连接配件」提示，该提示是否出现取决于哪台 Mac 插在哪台上）。 发送端会自动把会话转移到线缆上，即使是会话中途插入的线缆也可以，并且设备行会显示 Cable。 配有 Mini DisplayPort 外形的雷雳 1 或 2 接口的旧款 Mac，可以使用雷雳 3 转 2 转接器和雷雳 2 线缆。 来自接收端 Mac 的键盘和鼠标输入是后续计划中的功能（#147）。

paragraphs.en: Which settings give the best picture? Out of the box OpenDisplay already picks the sharpest setup it can, so you rarely need to change anything. The defaults are: sender on Best , receiver at its Default display setting, and video filling the receiver's screen (fullscreen). If you want to tune it, four things matter.
paragraphs.zh: 哪些设置能带来最佳画质？ 开箱即用时，OpenDisplay 已经会自动选择它能达到的最清晰的配置，因此你几乎不需要做任何改动。 默认设置为：发送端使用“最佳”（Best），接收端保持其“默认”（Default）显示设置，视频填满接收端的屏幕（全屏）。 如果你想进行调优，有四个方面需要注意。

paragraphs.en: 1. The connection. A cable gives steadier latency than WiFi, but it does not need to be fast: the stream uses at most 18 Mb/s.
paragraphs.zh: 1. 连接。 有线网络比 WiFi 延迟更稳定，但它不需要很快：视频流最多使用 18 Mb/s。

paragraphs.en: 2. The sender's quality setting. Best sends the full resolution. Balanced and Fast send fewer pixels: the image is softer, but encoding is faster, so motion is smoother and latency lower. The desktop's size stays the same.
paragraphs.zh: 2. 发送方的画质设置。 「最佳」发送完整分辨率。 「均衡」和「快速」发送更少的像素：图像更柔和，但编码更快，因此运动更流畅、延迟更低。 桌面的大小保持不变。

paragraphs.en: 3. Display size, per device, in the sender's device list (the arrows button next to Disconnect): Larger Text , Default , More Space or Native (1x) . Each choice shows the exact desktop size it gives, like macOS's own Displays settings. More Space and Native look a little softer when the receiver cannot show that many pixels 1:1. The choice is remembered per device across reconnects, cable or WiFi, and rotation. Changing the virtual display's resolution in System Settings does not stick (OpenDisplay puts its own size back); use Display size instead.
paragraphs.zh: 3. 每台设备在发送方设备列表中的显示尺寸（「断开连接」旁的箭头按钮）：更大文字、默认、更多空间或原生 (1x)。 每个选项都会显示其对应的确切桌面尺寸，就像 macOS 自带的显示器设置一样。 当接收端无法 1:1 显示那么多像素时，「更多空间」和「原生」看起来会稍微柔和一些。 该选择会按设备记住，在重新连接、有线或 WiFi 以及旋转屏幕后依然生效。 在系统设置中更改虚拟显示器的分辨率不会生效（OpenDisplay 会恢复自己的尺寸）；请改用显示尺寸设置。

paragraphs.en: Why H.264 and HEVC, and not AV1? Both have fast hardware encode and decode, and the latency is excellent. At the same resolution they run at the same frame rate on Apple silicon, but HEVC is sharper right after a window change and holds detail much better on a slow link. It is also the only way to send a 5K panel 1:1. So OpenDisplay uses HEVC whenever both Macs support it in hardware and falls back to H.264 everywhere else, with nothing to configure. iPhones and iPads with an A9 chip or later decode HEVC too. Colour detail is the same with both, because both send colour at a quarter of the resolution (4:2:0); fuller colour is tracked in #322 .
paragraphs.zh: 为什么选择 H.264 和 HEVC，而不是 AV1？ 两者都有快速的硬件编码和解码，而且延迟表现极佳。 在相同分辨率下，它们在 Apple 芯片上能以相同的帧率运行，但 HEVC 在窗口变化后能更快恢复清晰，在慢速链路上也更能保留细节。 它也是以 1:1 方式驱动 5K 显示屏的唯一途径。 因此，当两台 Mac 都支持硬件级 HEVC 时，OpenDisplay 就会使用 HEVC，其他情况下则回退到 H.264，无需任何配置。搭载 A9 或更新芯片的 iPhone 和 iPad 也能解码 HEVC。 两者呈现的色彩细节相同，因为二者都以四分之一分辨率（4:2:0）发送色彩；更完整的色彩支持见 #322。

paragraphs.en: The OpenDisplay Linux sender ( od-sender ) extends a Linux desktop onto any OpenDisplay receiver (iPhone, iPad, Android, or a spare Mac) by creating a virtual display sized for it. The beta is tested on Omarchy / Hyprland 0.56 on Apple silicon (Asahi) ; x86_64 is expected to work. Sway 1.10+, KDE Plasma 6.8+ and GNOME 50+ are experimental. Video is CPU-encoded for now (VA-API planned), and the stream is not encrypted, so use a network you trust.
paragraphs.zh: OpenDisplay Linux 发送端（od-sender）通过创建一个为其定制的虚拟显示器，将 Linux 桌面扩展到任何 OpenDisplay 接收端（iPhone、iPad、Android 或闲置的 Mac）上。 该测试版已在 Apple 芯片（Asahi）上的 Omarchy / Hyprland 0.56 进行过测试；x86_64 预计也可正常工作。 Sway 1.10+、KDE Plasma 6.8+ 和 GNOME 50+ 为实验性支持。 视频目前使用 CPU 编码（计划支持 VA-API），且视频流未加密，因此请使用你信任的网络。

paragraphs.en: od-receiver turns a Linux machine's screen into the display, for a Mac or a Linux desktop. It is tested windowed on Asahi Linux / Hyprland (aarch64), at 24 ms end to end; other desktops are expected to work. Install it from the same release as a Flatpak bundle (any distribution) or, on Arch / Omarchy, build its package from this repository with makepkg -si ; see linux/README.md#linux-receiver-beta . Reports go to #284 .

paragraphs.en: MAC (sender) iPHONE / iPAD (receiver) CGVirtualDisplay ← macOS believes a monitor is attached → ScreenCaptureKit (capture the virtual display) → VideoToolbox H.264 or HEVC (hardware, real-time) → TCP [4-byte length][Annex B frame] ═══════→ NWListener :9000 → AVSampleBufferDisplayLayer ← JSON control messages (hello, touch, scroll) ═══ → CGEvent injection (click / drag / scroll) The phone listens and the Mac connects — that ordering is what makes the exact same code work over USB (via the usbmuxd daemon built into every macOS install) and WiFi. An iPhone or iPad announces its panel pixels; a Mac receiver announces the backing size of its current scaled display mode. The sender creates an @2x CGVirtualDisplay with the corresponding logical working area, negotiates a codec-safe stream raster, and streams the pixels back.
paragraphs.zh: MAC（发送端）iPhone / iPad（接收端）CGVirtualDisplay ← macOS 认为已连接了一台显示器 → ScreenCaptureKit（采集虚拟显示器）→ VideoToolbox H.264 或 HEVC（硬件实时编码）→ TCP [4 字节长度][Annex B 帧] ═══════→ NWListener :9000 → AVSampleBufferDisplayLayer ← JSON 控制消息（hello、touch、scroll）═══ → CGEvent 注入（点击 / 拖拽 / 滚动）。手机负责监听而 Mac 负责连接——正是这个顺序安排让完全相同的代码既能通过 USB（借助每台 macOS 都内置的 usbmuxd 守护进程）也能通过 WiFi 工作。 iPhone 或 iPad 通告其面板像素；Mac 接收端通告其当前缩放显示模式的后备尺寸。 发送端创建一个 @2x 的 CGVirtualDisplay，设置相应的逻辑工作区域，协商一个编解码器安全的流光栅，并把像素流回传。

paragraphs.en: The phone log is the half usually missing from a WiFi report: whether the receiver ever announced itself, whether its listener restarted, whether the decoder was failing. Attach both if you can.
